findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

The observed learning window is [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; the representation is native model endpoint world coordinates, so any temporal contrast must be evaluated only on this observed support without extrapolation.

Supplied continuous contrast features show non-monotone behavior across the observed window: landmark_00_soft_mass has 4 sign changes with first_rate_z 9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00, and landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts and relative node RMSE 0.78; a constant rule is therefore not supported by these observed-node linear fits.

Several local coordinate contrasts have large opposing first and last rate z-scores (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z -72.37 vs last_rate_z 5.52; landmark_00_local_cyy first_rate_z -36.49 vs last_rate_z 17.14), indicating rate changes within the observed window rather than a single stable direction.

No polynomial fit is accepted for the inspected continuous trends (polynomial_accepted false) and extrapolation is disallowed, so time-conditioned rules must rely on validated fits or observed-node interpolation only.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast attention over observed score nodes
hypotheses.falsifier: A constant rule matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule on held-out observed-node contrast fidelity without additional sign conflicts.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx contrast values at observed score times
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule that follows the observed-node sign and rate changes of landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx within [0.0, 0.49] would track the supplied contrast evidence better than a constant rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: A monotone fit with accepted polynomial and low relative node RMSE explains the same features.
hypotheses.observable: first_rate_z and last_rate_z of local coordinate contrast features
hypotheses.statement: The large opposing first and last rate z-scores in local coordinate contrasts reflect within-window rate turnover rather than a stable monotone coordinate trend.

limitations: Only continuous_trends rows and clock/objective metadata were read; branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, survival_effects, turnover_accounting, joint_diagnostics, lineage_support and regional_effects were not inspected, so selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptors and descendant survival credit remain unassessed.
No decoded terminal labels or current study outcome data are available, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Coordinate contrasts are endpoint-world-A features under a detached VJP reward; they are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and were not proposed for edit.
